subject: Justin Tseng City Council Candidate Profile
overview: Justin Tseng presented his platform for re-election to the Medford City Council, highlighting his record on municipal transparency, school funding, and infrastructure repair. He outlined future priorities including housing affordability, civil rights, and rebuilding the high school.

items.title: Opening statement and legislative record
items.summary: Tseng presented his record from the last four years, citing investments in road repair crews and the preservation of teaching positions.

items.title: Personal background and education
items.summary: He described his upbringing in Medford as the son of immigrants and how public education prepared him for Harvard University and law school.

items.title: Housing affordability and zoning reform
items.summary: Tseng detailed his work on the affordable housing trust and zoning reforms while proposing future developer linkage fees and an affordable housing overlay.

items.title: Civil rights and welcoming city status
items.summary: He addressed the importance of welcoming city ordinances and ensuring that municipal services remain accessible to all residents regardless of immigration status.

items.title: Infrastructure and school investments
items.summary: He advocated for continued investment in sidewalk repairs and rebuilding the high school to improve the quality of city services.

items.title: Closing and re-election bid
items.summary: Tseng concluded by requesting voter support to maintain progress and avoid returning to the previous political status quo.
